result_text:
The contributor lists and the recent-commits bar chart no longer stop at `contributorsListLimit`. The reports module compiles and its tests pass (`mvn -q -o -pl reports test`). I did not generate a landscape report to look at the output.

Changes, both in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/`:

- **`LandscapeContributorsReport.java`** (`saveContributorsTable`): removed the `.limit(limit)` on the table stream and the "The list is limited to N items (out of M)." note. Every contributor is now written, in the same sort order as before. This covers `contributors.html`, `contributors-recent.html`, `bots.html` and the teams pages, since they all go through this method.
- **`ContributorListsSection.java`** (`getBarsHtml`): removed the `.limit(...)` on the bar chart stream, so there is one bar per recently active contributor.

`contributorsListLimit` is still in `LandscapeConfiguration` and is now unused. I left it in place, as the task asked. Nothing is committed.
